reviews.text: excellent!!!
Everything's fine, it's my first time visiting Animal Salut.
As always, excellent service!
They are true professionals; they treat my dog ​​with love and care. They are all wonderful, thank you for your patience with her.
I take my dog ​​there and they take very good care of her.
Excellent veterinary and grooming service 💕✅ …
My Bichon Maltese puppy came out of the groomer looking gorgeous, with a perfect haircut, and the little blue bow was the finishing touch. She looks absolutely adorable!

Nerea and Jessica's service was spectacular and very professional.

If you have any doubts about shaving your cats, don't hesitate.

July 28, 2026
I gave them a 5-star rating before, but now I'm lowering it to a 2. I called the other day to have their fur shaved again, and they told me they've changed the price (no problem, travel, etc., etc., reasonable). Last time, I think they charged me €125 per cat (sedation and shaving). Now they're telling me they've raised it to €250 per cat 😱😱

Fantastic veterinarians! Their home visit was a great success for me, as my dog ​​gets anxious traveling in cars.
Thank you for your excellent work!
Camila's vet was super professional. My cat Camila's vet.

I had my dog ​​neutered and everything went perfectly! The women there are amazing, they're so caring and they follow up closely. I would definitely leave him with them again and I recommend them 100%. Thank you so much, ladies! ❤️
Highly recommend! We were very happy with the home visits.
What a wonderful hair salon! I took my poodle Cole there for the first time and he came out thrilled with Jessi! We'll be back! 😍 …
A 100% trustworthy vet; they care for and pamper our pets as if they were their own. Highly recommended. I take my three cats and two dogs there and I'm delighted. A 10 out of 10, without a doubt.
Our visit to the vet was excellent! The doctor was very nice and caring. The service was very good.

I really enjoyed it. The service and especially the suggestions for my puppy were great.
Very friendly service. I highly recommend it!
I take Igris there with complete peace of mind. They're always punctual and attentive; it's not just the vaccination, they do a full check-up. They're friendly and helpful.
Perfect service and attention, I am calm if my furry friend is in your hands.
Excellent service and professionalism
Very nice and very patient. We have been with them for years and they have always taken very good care of our dog, being very attentive to our concerns and doubts. Highly recommended!

Very positive experience with the home service of Nerea (veterinarian) and Jessica (hairdresser). Both were very professional, kind and friendly and treated our cat with great care.

They showed a lot of experience, working with great delicacy, in a gentle and safe way, transmitting a lot of peace of mind at all times.

In addition, they advised us very well, recommending hair products, medicines and natural supplements, taking into account that our cat is already 17 years old.

Very comfortable and high quality service. Totally recommended, we will repeat for sure!
Having home visits is fantastic, because it means my cats don't get so stressed! And the service is phenomenal.
I recommend it. Good service, prices, and professionalism. Very friendly and make an effort to adapt to the customer. They make it very easy.
Thank you Nerea 😻😻super …
Very friendly
This is the second time I've gotten travel papers for my dogs, and everything has gone very smoothly. The vets know the procedure perfectly and have been attentive throughout the entire process.
They do not accept emergencies.
I took my kitten Arturito there and was very satisfied. They were very kind and answered all my questions. 100% recommended.

If you love your pet, I highly recommend this center. I've been going there for 10 years with my dog ​​and cat. Just this past weekend, my cat had an upper respiratory infection and they referred her to a hospital and monitored her day and night. They helped me understand the diagnosis, the medication guidelines, and what to expect in case of emergencies. The best part? My cat is home with me now, healthy and well, and being closely monitored. Thank you, Mire, for being there!
My recommendation is that if you love your animals, don't go to this veterinary clinic!

Terrible experience. My senior cat received incorrect treatment, his information was poorly handled, the prescription was incorrectly delivered, and his condition deteriorated, requiring hospitalization at another clinic. I absolutely do not recommend this clinic.
The service was excellent. Berta and Nerea treat the animals wonderfully and explore all possible treatments. They keep you informed about everything and follow up after the treatment is finished.
Very good attention and excellent hairdressing service
The vet came to my home, she was very attentive, very kind and explained things very well, the check-up was perfect and both my cat and I were delighted.
We took our cat Bruno to the emergency vet and they treated us wonderfully, with great professionalism and care. We were very satisfied. We will definitely recommend them. Thank you so much.

Always in good hands.
Thank you.
They collaborate with the association with all the rescued cats, both visits and surgeries. Very good treatment, and attention! Many thanks Mireia and the whole team!!
Exceptional service thanks to the two professionals: Jessica and Nerea. They are undoubtedly my cat's official veterinarians and groomers. Thank you so much!
They do a great job, they're kind and caring with the animals. Very happy.
Very professional and friendly ❤️

Highly recommended veterinary center, the staff are very professional, the veterinarians are excellent, and the groomer Jessica is a top-notch professional, thank you for taking such good care of my Yorkshire Terrier.
They treated my Dachshund wonderfully, Nerea was a sweetheart 😍😍😍😍 …
The truth is that veterinarians are very kind and friendly with animals.
A fantastic experience! They came to my house and treated my dog ​​with so much love. It's wonderful to find professionals like this, who make things easy and genuinely care. Highly recommended!
What a wonderful clinic! All the vets take great care of my cat, Mori. And the receptionist is super nice! Thank you all so much for looking after her.
We have a cat, and they made a home visit for a check-up and vaccinations, so he was more relaxed and didn't have to go outside. Mireia was very attentive and answered all our questions.

Excellent service and attention.
I've been taking my Bengal cat there for a year now and I'm delighted with the care he's received, both from the veterinarian and the other staff at the shop. They treat my cat with kindness, professionalism, and respect; 100% recommended.
Fantastic deal! ❤️❤️❤️
The home visit service was wonderful! They're amazing! My furry friend recovered very quickly :)
Excellent service, super friendly

Great! It's the veterinary center and we come specifically from another district for the treatment and trust. Drac loves Mireia!
They also have a shop that can also solve many things for you!
I've always felt very comfortable going to this clinic, noticing my pet's improvement every time I've taken her. I've been going for a while now, and they're all very professional and friendly.

We are very happy with the treatment received by the staff. It is difficult to find veterinarians so attentive and who are proficient in exotic animals.
We brought our guinea pig, we are very happy. They also have a shop with everything you need for your pet

We are delighted, we have trusted them for years. First we did the check-ups at the vet, but our cat has grown up and gets very stressed when leaving the house, they have been coming to our house for a couple of years to do the check-ups and it is much better for him.
Highly recommended😊

I called because I have an emergency with my dog, and they told me they couldn't fit me in and that I should go to another vet. This is where they have my dog's file, and the appointment wouldn't be very long, 15 minutes at most. I was shocked that they wouldn't attend to an emergency and told me to find another vet.
I suppose it's the receptionist's fault, not the vet's.
Excellent service and treatment for my cats, I have been taking them for several years now and I couldn't be happier.
Excellent, thank you

The entire team provided exceptional service. I love them, not only for their professionalism but also for the compassionate care they gave my cat during both the treatments and follow-up appointments. I recommend them 1000%!

Mireia is very professional and has given me a lot of confidence! My cat has been able to receive care at home without the stress of leaving the house! We are both very grateful! I recommend Mireia 100%!
I'm so grateful to the vet; she treats my kitten Yuri with so much love that you can tell how much she enjoys her job. 🥰 …

We met the vet during a house call, in a moment of desperation with Odi, one of our cats, since our usual clinic couldn't find the problem. In just one visit, she diagnosed the issue and saved him. Since then, she's been our vet for both of our cats. For me, she's simply unbeatable.
The home veterinarian is a very friendly and understanding professional with the reluctance of our cat Audrey. Reasonable price. Thanks Mireia, see you in a few months.
Excellent! They've been taking care of my cats for 10 years now. They are professional, and all the staff are very kind. The veterinarians Berta and Mireia are meticulous and excellent professionals.

This is the second time I've booked an appointment to get my cat's hair cut (he has long hair, hardly lets me brush him, and it gets matted). This time I also included his vaccinations and deworming. Both the groomer and the vet were fantastic—super professional, friendly, and you can tell they care deeply about the animals. I'll definitely be back.
An excellent team, 100% professional
Excellent service, friendly and professional.

Very attentive and kind.
It's a great place to have your child looked after; they advise you on everything and explain it in detail. Their work is very efficient. And the prices are quite good these days. Completely professional. I'll be back soon, also for my little one's vaccinations or anything else she might need. ♥️
Thank you so much! 🙂
The best veterinarians in Barcelona. The team's professionalism and speed are outstanding. My cat is thrilled, and if she's healthy and happy, so are we. Thank you, Mireia, for always being there.

Excellent professionals! I've been taking Sammy there for years and it's been fantastic. A special mention to Berta, who takes care of him; she's attentive and caring, and you can tell she loves her job. Thank you so much for the care and dedication you give to our pets!
Brilliant
My cat got a fantastic haircut! The vet and especially the groomer were very professional, and it was so convenient to have it done at home. I'll definitely be back! The before and after are amazing!
If you want to be well taken care of, I recommend this place; they are fast and efficient. I'm very happy that they...
Joy always goes to visits happy, and the experience is always very positive. She's also very friendly.

They've been taking care of my cats for eight years, making house calls, especially since one of them is extremely timid. From day one, they've offered very professional and respectful treatment of the animals, adapting to each cat's individual needs. I'm very happy with their services.
Mirea was lovely and very professional. She came to my house to check on my cat and treated him with so much care. 100% recommended

I took my dog ​​to the groomer on Friday. He came out with one eye red and half-closed. The next day I took him to my vet. Conjunctivitis; he's being treated... I absolutely do not recommend this place.
Excellent professionals who always provide great service. Thank you Mireia and Jessi
The vet is a good professional
Mireia is a wonderful professional! Very empathetic and respectful with my kitten. 10 out of 10.
The staff provided excellent service and were very helpful!
Great as always
We're so glad we met Mireia the vet and that she offers a home visit service. Our kittens were terrified of going to the vet, and she's made our lives so much easier. Excellent service!

I found this veterinary clinic precisely because of the excellent reviews, and they're all true!

I've been taking my cat, Rock, there for eight months now, and we're delighted with the care and affection they show our furry friend. They prioritize the animals' well-being over price.

Thank you to all the staff, especially Berta, for your love and passion for animals, your advice, and your professionalism.

You're all wonderful! :)

We are delighted to have Animal Salut by our side. Our Mango is a dog, who for various reasons, is very fearful and Berta's tact and excellent skills make us all feel at ease. We certainly feel in good hands.
Excellent care and advice for my dog ​​Kitty from all the professionals who work at this center, especially Berta and María. I recommend them 100%.

This is the first time I've called Animal Salut, and I'm so glad I did. My kitten Calimero is very shy and timid, so I always prefer the vet to come to my house. Mireia came, and the service was outstanding. She was incredibly patient and very gentle with him. It wasn't easy, but thanks to her kindness and professionalism, everything went perfectly. I will definitely use them again. Thank you so much!
Fantastic! A 10 for service and professionalism :)
The hairdresser took a short time and was very good, I am very happy, and Gubby is beautiful. Very friendly with people and very affectionate with dogs. The vets too.
Very attentive and professional, I am delighted by the human and friendly treatment.

I've been taking my poodle Saimon to this grooming salon for over two years now, and we're delighted with Jessi's attention and professionalism. My dog ​​always leaves there looking handsome and happy!

Thank you so much for treating our animals so well; they're part of our family.
We've been taking Balú and Lía to the groomer for years and we're delighted. Jessi is very professional and caring with the furry ones.
Excellent service 👍, I recommend you …
Thank you!
I took my cat to get her hair cut, and they treated Kahlo very well. They were super friendly and professional. We'll definitely be back for the rest of our furry friends.

Excellent treatment of people and animals, kindness, and great patience in explaining doubts and possible alternatives. They have a lot of love for animals. I love their professionalism, their prices, and above all, that they also consider the owners' budgets; they're not one of those vets who are there just to make you spend money.

Perfect service and very friendly, I highly recommend them.

Thank you.

We have been several times and our veterinarian is Berta, we are delighted with her professionalism and treatment of our dog Kai, she has always solved any problem we have had, you can see the love she has for animals.
Delighted with Animal Salutación, they quickly identified what was wrong with my dog ​​and she has improved tremendously with the treatment, thank you so much

Many thanks to the entire team, and especially to Mireia. They always treated us with such empathy and kindness, particularly during the most difficult times. Our cat was ill from birth until she passed away, and Mireia always cared for her. Most importantly, she was there for us and helped us give her the best life we ​​could for years. We will be eternally grateful for everything they did for her and for us.
Clean place. Kind and helpful staff. Mireia can speak English and it’s good for foreigners. I took my cat and they did her grooming great . Thanks 🙏🏻🌸 …

We've been going to Animal Salut for seven years. First at the Sagrera center, and then we moved outside of Barcelona and continued with home visits. They always treat Goli (our rabbit) wonderfully and he never gets nervous, which is hard to achieve. Plus, they remind you to schedule the annual checkups—they're the best!
